public_rationale: The career record is consistent with a background concentrated in livestreaming. It does not establish how much professional AI experience Shear had. Twitch also faced copyright enforcement, making a broad reading of 'never' questionable. The available records do not establish his personal involvement or whether those challenges were substantially comparable to OpenAI’s. The combined assertion cannot be settled fairly.
limitations: A short biography cannot prove the absence of experience.
Company-level legal experience cannot automatically be attributed to its CEO.
The meaning of comparable challenges materially affects the assessment.

our_interpretation: Assess Shear’s career before his appointment, through the post date. The retrospective word 'never' makes his prior career the relevant period.
The ordinary reading is limited professional AI experience and no prior responsibility for substantially comparable legal or regulatory challenges.
General technology management experience does not establish substantial AI experience. Conversely, comparable challenges need not have arisen at an AI company.
No numerical threshold for 'much' or definition of comparable challenges is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete career record establishes limited professional AI experience and no prior responsibility for legal or regulatory challenges substantially comparable to those facing AI companies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish substantial professional AI experience or personal responsibility for substantially comparable legal or regulatory challenges before the post.
